also_known_as: Ku Klux Klan Act, Third Enforcement Act
source_description: Statutes at Large, Volume 17, pages 13-15. PDF scan of enrolled act.
retrieval_steward: Claude (assistant) under steward direction — Michael Hartmann
transcription_method: Manual transcription from PDF scan of original Statutes at Large page. OCR artifacts in PDF required human-assisted reading; text verified against two secondary sources (uscode.house.gov and law.cornell.edu) for the provisions that survived into current §1983.
notes: Section 1 of the 1871 Act is the ONLY section that became 42 USC §1983. Sections 2-7 became other provisions (§1985, expired, or repealed). The PDF contains all 7 sections across pages 13-15 of 17 Stat.
